children: may retest a resistance at $5,538 per metric ton, a break above which could lead to a gain into $5,665-$5,793 range.
A projection analysis suggests a completion of a wave c from $6,206, as a decent bounce occurred around the key support at $5,124, the 100% level and one of the possible endpoints of this wave.
A break below $5,380 may trigger a fall into $5,124-$5,272 range.
